text: The art of carpentry comprises the creation of furniture and structures using various tools and methods. Joints, including the榫 (xuàn) joint, are crucial for connecting wooden pieces together to construct a solid structure. These joints facilitate smooth transitions between different sections of the project, preventing warping or deformation over time. Furthermore, the application of varnish is often necessary to protect and enhance the appearance of the finished product. A finishing process involves applying a thin layer of varnish or paint to smooth out rough edges or imperfections and create a durable, weather-resistant finish.
